subject: Post-discovery: Redwood implementation preview & technical run-through
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: Redwood implementation preview & technical run-through

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday. Based on what you shared about anticipated throughput and VPC requirements, I think the best next step is a focused implementation preview for your infra and security teams — a 60-minute technical session where we walk the proposed architecture, data flows, and what a pilot/POC would look like.

Proposed agenda (30–60 min):
- 5 min: goals and success criteria
- 15 min: high-level architecture + deployment options (hosted vs. private)
- 20 min: networking, KV cache, batching, and SLOs
- 10 min: pilot timeline & next steps / Q&A

I have availability next week on:
- Tue 11/9: 10:00–11:00 PT, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 11/10: 09:00–11:00 PT

I'll bring the implementation playbook and a short technical deck as pre-read (attached). If you can share the names of the infra/security leads you'd like on the call I will include them in the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on an execution plan.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_implementation_playbook_v0.3.pdf

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks — this looks great. We definitely want our infra and security folks on the session. My suggested attendees: Amir Singh (platform lead), Lauren Morris (security), and myself.

The times you suggested next week are a bit tight for us. Can we aim for Mon 11/9 or Tue 11/10 in the afternoon PST? Preferably after 13:00 PT. Also — can you share the playbook/slide deck ahead of time so our security team can scan for any networking/KMS questions?

Appreciate it,
Jamie Ortega
Head of Partnerships | Blue Harbor AI
